title: The Export Wave Is Cresting
text:
The Export Wave Is Cresting

Andrew Batson

Gavekal Dragonomics | 23 Sep 2026

China’s latest extraordinary export wave is showing signs of cresting. The headline YoY growth of exports has leveled off over the past three months, staying around 24-27% in US dollar terms and 18-20% in renminbi terms. The boom in exports of products associated with investment in artificial intelligence is certainly not over, but current super-high growth rates will probably slow in coming months.Memory chips are now the biggest single swing factor for exports, and prices for some products have recently leveled off after their massive surge. While the ebb and flow of memory prices is difficult to forecast, growth of total exports in 2027 will most likely converge toward the recent trend for products outside the AI complex, which is around 5-7%. But these semiconductor cycles have limited implications for China’s vast range of other exports, which are still very competitive in global markets.
